# Twin Bridge Roofing & Construction

> Family-owned, BBB A+ accredited roofing and exterior contractor serving the Quad Cities (Davenport & Bettendorf, Iowa; Moline, East Moline, Rock Island & Milan, Illinois) and surrounding communities from Galesburg to Macomb. Licensed in Illinois and Iowa. Specialists in storm damage inspections and insurance claim roof replacement, with a licensed public adjuster on staff. Free inspections and instant online roof estimates. QCBR 2024 Remodeler of the Year. 2026 BBB Torch Award for Ethics winner. Phone: (309) 948-4126.

## Business facts
- Legal name: Twin Bridge Construction LLC, doing business as Twin Bridge Roofing & Construction (also known as RoofQC)
- Address: 801 1st St E, Ste 2, Milan, IL 61264
- Phone: (309) 948-4126
- Email: info@roofqc.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
- Credentials: BBB Accredited since 2021, A+ rating; QCBR 2024 Remodeler of the Year; 2026 BBB Torch Award for Ethics; TAMKO Diamond Pro Certified Contractor; licensed public adjuster on staff
- Owner: James Reans — Immediate Past President, Quad Cities Builders & Remodelers (QCBR); licensed building inspector; FAA Part 107 drone pilot
- Service area: Davenport, Bettendorf, LeClaire, Eldridge, Long Grove, Park View, Blue Grass, Walcott (Iowa); Moline, East Moline, Rock Island, Milan, Coal Valley, Silvis, Colona, Sherrard, Orion, Andover, Aledo, Geneseo, Port Byron, Galesburg, Monmouth, Macomb (Illinois)
- Services: asphalt shingle roof replacement (TAMKO Titan XT Class 3, Stormfighter Flex Class 4 impact-resistant), composite/synthetic roofing (Brava), metal roofing, roof repair, storm/hail/wind damage inspection, insurance claim assistance, vinyl and steel siding, seamless aluminum gutters and gutter guards, financing
- Financing: "As low as" monthly payments through Foundation Finance Company, 144-month term at 11.9% APR with approved credit; rate and term depend on credit approval
